findings.effect: healthy macro-cycle recurs across the trajectory
seven procedures, human decision authority and one runtime/store direction stabilize from the mid-trajectory
repository evidence becomes separated from E3 human/governance and E4 deployment evidence
enhancer/finalizer/cascade-resolver ownership generated UIUX debt until retirement
committed planning files repeatedly lagged a merge and required a later reconciliation PR
stacked/ref/tooling failures caused rematerialization/revert churn without equivalent product gain
large trial counts were insufficient when oracle/model correlation or semantic blind spots survived

governanceAssessment.repair: Git owns live merge/head facts; committed governance stores immutable observations plus durable dependency-derived planning state; no post-merge reconciliation is required merely to advance a merged serial milestone.

prototypeAssessment.reason: The repository already proves the bounded prototype substrate; remaining convergence work is naturally owned by UIUX-CONVERGE-0/C5 or existing conditional slices.

claimBoundary: Repository/trajectory evidence only. The audit does not prove representative human usability, legal compliance, certification, market fit, production deployment effectiveness, HA, approved RTO/RPO, enterprise-candidate status or enterprise readiness.
